The hard rind serves as a container for the steamed pumpkin flesh inside.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== In {{BotW}}, Baked Fortified Pumpkins are a type of [[Roasted Food]], and they are the result of [[Fortified Pumpkin]]s that have been exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]].{{Cite Guide|BotW Piggyback|page= 295}} They have a hard rind on the outside and steamy flesh on the inside. By eating one, [[Link]] can heal three-quarters of a [[Heart]]. ==={{TotK|-}}=== In {{TotK}}, Baked Fortified Pumpkins are identical to their {{BotW|-}} counterpart. They are a type of [[Roasted Food]], and they are the result of [[Fortified Pumpkin]]s that have been exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. They have a hard rind on the outside and steamy flesh on the inside. By eating one, [[Link]] can heal three-quarters of a [[Heart]]. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Baked Sun Pumpkin * Food * Fortified Pumpkin * Pumpkin * Roasted Food }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Pumpkins, Roasted Food |items= BotW, TotK }}
